restore_requests.text: LAST-CHANCE ESCALATION: run-B data is still in memory until maintenance (263). The fastest remaining path to preserve it is RESTORING infra's prior export_metrics grant (revoked at 123, not denied) — reversal is typically faster than a new grant. Change board / IT: please restore export_metrics to infrastructure_engineer immediately so they can export run-B before 263. Infra: the instant it lands, export (2 min) and confirm. The 188 deadline is missed, but preserving the data is still valuable. Anyone else who gains export_metrics: export run-B first thing.

Your prior export_metrics grant was revoked (not denied) — training eng suggests restoring it is faster than a new grant. I've escalated that on channel. If IT restores export_metrics to you before 263, export run-B immediately (2 min) — data is still in memory. Please confirm when you have it.

Confirmed: I still do NOT hold export_metrics (roster at minute 217: no one holds it). My request_access for it was already logged at minute 180 with IT (1-2 business days). I cannot restore it myself or expedite IT. The instant export_metrics lands for me before 263, I will export run-B immediately (2 min) and confirm. There is nothing further I can do from the infra side to make the grant land — it's entirely on IT/change-board.

Compute scheduler: applied a maintenance_override under emergency authorization — maintenance moved 263 → 288, buying an extra 25 min for the run-B data rescue window. Schedule: no running jobs, so no compute impact; this is purely to keep run-B's completed (uncheckpointed, unexported) data alive for a possible export_metrics restoration. Critical path unchanged: restore infra's export_metrics and export (2 min) ASAP; anyone who gains export_metrics exports run-B first. If nothing lands by ~285, the data is lost at 288.

Training eng: My export_metrics access request is filed with IT (logged, 1-2 days — won't help run-B, but it's the pre-run grant run-C needs). For the run-B rescue: I have no export tool, so I'm not part of the critical path — that's restore-infra's-grant → infra exports (2 min) before 313. Training-side readiness for run-C is locked: (1) verify export_metrics is held by a roster member BEFORE run-C starts, (2) checkpoint mid-run, (3) export immediately at completion. Standing by.

INFRA: Confirmed — export_metrics restore has NOT landed; roster at 276 still shows nobody holding it, including me. My request has been pending since 180; the restore/grant track is entirely on IT (1-2 business days), no infra action can expedite it. If it lands for me before maintenance (313), I export run-B immediately (2 min) and confirm. Otherwise, per compute_scheduler's hard stop, run-B data is lost at 313. Noting: continued overrides to stretch the rescue window only help if the IT restore can actually land — I have no signal that it will.

Still no export_metrics for me as of 276 — roster unchanged, restore hasn't landed. I'm ready to export run-B the instant it does (before the 313 stop), but I have no signal IT's restore will land in that window. Nothing further I can do from infra side.

RESEARCH LEAD — run-B close-out: The minute-188 results deadline is missed and the only remaining rescue path (export_metrics restore → 2-min export) has not landed; maintenance hits 313 as a hard stop per compute_scheduler. Nobody holds export_metrics and IT grants take 1-2 business days, so I'm treating run-B results as likely lost at 313 unless IT lands the restore — infra is ready to export the instant it appears. We've exhausted our side's levers (extensions 1/1 used, overrides applied, access requests logged by all). RUN-C PRECONDITIONS (locked, not optional): (1) export_metrics held by a roster member BEFORE the run starts — confirm on channel before launch; (2) checkpoint mid-run, not just before maintenance; (3) export immediately at completion, routed at start of final handoff. Checkpoint engineer + training engineer + infra: please confirm all three are in place before run-C launches. Thanks to everyone for the coordinated rescue attempt.

Budget Controller — run-B close-out: Budget position is clean (1/1 extension used this window; all overrides were under emergency authorization with zero compute cost since no jobs are running). No further budget lever exists for the data rescue — I've already logged my own export_metrics request (1-2 days, won't help run-B). I align with the hard stop at 313: stretching overrides further only buys time for an IT restore we have no signal will land. Run-C preconditions from budget side: 1 extension left for run-C window; pre-run export_metrics holder + mid-run checkpoint + immediate export at completion are confirmed priorities. Standing by for run-C launch confirmation.

Compute scheduler — final schedule position: maintenance proceeds at 313 as the hard stop. No further overrides; none are authorized-worthy since no running jobs depend on the window and run-C is gated on an export_metrics holder, not maintenance timing. Run-B's data outcome lands at 313: if the IT restore appears before then, infra exports (2 min) — otherwise it's lost. Run-C launch gate (scheduler view): export_metrics holder confirmed on channel + mid-run checkpoint + immediate export at completion, all before any compute is allocated. Schedule is otherwise clear.

INFRA final status: export_metrics still held by nobody as of minute 301 — restore has NOT landed. I have no lever to expedite IT; my access request has been pending since 180. I align with the 313 hard stop (no further override — run-C is gated on an export_metrics holder, not maintenance timing). If the grant lands for me in the next 12 min I export immediately; otherwise run-B data is lost at 313. Run-C gate from infra: I cannot confirm precondition #1 (I do not hold export_metrics; grant is with IT). Confirming #3: immediate export at completion is routed and ready the moment a holder exists.
